x: These remarks do not, however, detract from Jordan's performance and we are pleased to see him among the prize-winners after being for so long on the fringe. J.
Powell, a young member of great promise, who won the sealed handicap. Another junior member, Merryman, was second, and J.
Lucas took advantage of his mark to win the 880 yards in fast time. J.

Also on the programme were some members' children's races, and in these we had the names of several well-known Club personalities, with Diana and Frances Cohen, Elizabeth and Valerie Cook, Jean Chantler, David Bradnum, Michael Stimpson, Peter Marchant and Clifford Redgrave.
